SS-FLEXBOX.Purpose: Self-contained Flexbox layout engine: a C# port of Yoga computing node measurements from styles, feeding layout rects to the widget runtime.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Flex/Node/Style calculation over the box model (flex direction, align, justify, wrap, grow/shrink/basis).
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Pixel-grid rounding and float comparison helpers. Widget property mapping onto styles — owned by SS-WIDGET-RUNTIME.

Principles.PRIN-001: The engine is dependency-free C#: no Unity, no RimWorld, no FlexVerse types.

Requirements.REQ-001: CalculateLayout(node, width, widthMode, height, heightMode) produces deterministic results for identical inputs.
